result.instructions: Alza.cz catalog and user-controlled shopping assistant. Unofficial — not affiliated with or endorsed by Alza.cz a.s. Use search_products to find items, get_product for full detail, get_product_reviews for ratings, find_pickup_points for nearby AlzaShop locations. Account, checkout, profile, and payment tools use the Alza mobile REST API with OAuth PKCE; credentials are never collected by the MCP. Order submission requires a checkout preview token and explicit user confirmation. High-impact mutations (payment, registration, address, review, subscription, attachment) require a one-time token from alza_prepare_mutation.

transportFallback.what: The account stack (MobileApi) was plain Node fetch and received the www/webapi bot-challenge HTML (403 + var getData) for every /services/restservice.svc route; the catalog stack was already browser-backed (AlzaBrowser) and worked. Verified with curl: both https://www.alza.cz and https://webapi.alza.cz serve the challenge page to plain clients.
transportFallback.change: src/infra/mobile-api.ts gained a typed structural browser dependency (BrowserPageHost, satisfied by AlzaBrowser) and fetchViaBrowser(): same-origin bot-challenge 403s are retried via an in-page fetch with credentials:include; a cold page navigates to the base origin first (about:blank cannot fetch cross-origin); one challenge-retry after a second navigation. src/server.ts wires the existing browser into MobileApi. Cross-host routes and JSON 403s are untouched; without a browser the plain-transport 403 is preserved.
transportFallback.tests: test/account.test.ts +4 (browser retry success path with goto/evaluate trace, still-challenged error surfacing, cross-host + non-challenge 403 no-browser engagement, no-browser preservation). Suite 70/70, typecheck + build clean.
transportFallback.gatewayRespawn: mcp connect alza respawns the registered stdio process, so the rebuilt dist took effect without /reload (verified: the first probe after rebuild surfaced the new page.evaluate path).
